name: TwilightOS 2026.11.27
body_html:
The first public release of TwilightOS: Arch Linux with a reworked KDE Plasma 6 desktop that feels familiar to Windows users.

Highlights

  • Dusk launcher, slim floating top bar, Quick Settings (Win+A), notifications, CPU/RAM monitor
  • Settings app with everything in-app: display, sound, Bluetooth, mouse and keyboard, network and VPN, accounts, privacy, time and language, accessibility
  • Task Manager (Ctrl+Shift+Esc), sign-out screen (Ctrl+Alt+Del), lock and sign-in screens with show-password
  • Setup, a step-by-step installer: btrfs with snapshots, themed GRUB boot menu, firewall on
  • Dark and light themes; accent colour recolours the icons
  • ~840 MB RAM and 0.0% CPU on an idle installed desktop (measured in a VM)

Download
GitHub limits release files to 2 GB, so the ISO comes in two parts. Download both parts and the .sha256, then join them:

Windows:

cmd /c copy /b twilightos-2026.11.27-x86_64.iso.part1 + twilightos-2026.11.27-x86_64.iso.part2 twilightos-2026.11.27-x86_64.iso

Linux / macOS:

cat twilightos-2026.11.27-x86_64.iso.part1 twilightos-2026.11.27-x86_64.iso.part2 > twilightos-2026.11.27-x86_64.iso
sha256sum -c twilightos-2026.11.27-x86_64.iso.sha256

Write it to a USB stick with Ventoy, Rufus (DD mode) or dd, turn Secure Boot off, and boot. Double-click Install TwilightOS on the desktop to install (it uses the whole disk you choose).

See the README for the full tour with screenshots.
